root_cause.text: The Btrfs filesystem aborts the transaction when `btrfs_uuid_tree_add` returns an `-EOVERFLOW` error due to a leaf item overflow of `BTRFS_UUID_KEY_RECEIVED_SUBVOL` when repeatedly snapshotting a received subvolume.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `create_pending_snapshot`, any error from `btrfs_uuid_tree_add` other than `-EEXIST` triggers `btrfs_abort_transaction(trans, ret)`. The fix adds a check to ignore `-EOVERFLOW` errors (`if (ret == -EOVERFLOW) ret = 0;`) to prevent the transaction abort.

intent_record.intent_summary: Ignore -EOVERFLOW errors when adding received UUIDs during snapshot creation to prevent unprivileged users from triggering transaction aborts.
intent_record.what: An explicit check was added to intercept and ignore the -EOVERFLOW error returned by btrfs_uuid_tree_add during snapshot creation.
intent_record.how: This change prevents the kernel from aborting the transaction when a leaf limit is reached for a received UUID, allowing snapshot creation to succeed safely.
